description: This file defines repository classes for database operations related to Users and Tasks, including user creation, authentication, and task management, using SQLAlchemy ORM. It also includes custom exceptions for error handling.

classes.name: DuplicateEmailError
classes.description: Exception raised when attempting to create a user with an email that already exists.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Handles database operations related to User entities, such as creating users and fetching by email.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Handles database operations related to Task entities, such as creating, listing, updating, and deleting tasks.

methods.name: User create_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password, handling integrity constraints such as duplicate emails.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, db: Session, *, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email, returns None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns the user if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: Task create_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int)
methods.description: Returns a list of tasks for a specific user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task by ID, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, is_completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates task details with safety checks, enforcing user ownership.

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task if it belongs to the specified user.
